input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 warrants only legality of performance (p0024), authority (p0025) and non-infringement (p0026), and § 1(b) contains a professional-and-workmanlike performance covenant (p0005). Nowhere does Contractor warrant that software or deliverables conform to their documentation or Specifications, no warranty period is stated, and there is no repair/replace/refund remedy (no responsive language on searches for conformity, refund or remedy; acceptance mechanic in § 4 does not supply one). With the implied warranties disclaimed in lieu of these narrow express warranties, the bargain falls below the fallback (90 days software, 30 days services, same remedies), so we propose the shortest fallback insert rather than the preferred 12-month/no-malicious-code package.

ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants that, for ninety (90) days following delivery, any software or other deliverable provided hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and that, for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will have been performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software, deliverable or Services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The warranty section contains no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no remedy, so the disclaimer leaves us with nothing to enforce. We have added our fallback position: 90 days conformance to documentation for software/deliverables, 30 days for Services, with repair, replacement or refund.
proposal.summary: Add fallback conformance warranty (90 days software/deliverables, 30 days Services) with repair, replacement or refund remedy

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
